mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies struggle with production and supply chain issues.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with high inflation, which increases the cost of capital and erodes real earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three months indicates a strong demand for housing, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the proxy is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
